title: AI Workflow Implementation Consulting Services Agreement
authoritative_draft:
This AI Workflow Implementation Consulting Services Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into by and between Harbor Peak Analytics LLC, as “Consultant,” and Ironvale Manufacturing Inc, as “Client,” effective as of October 1, 2026.

1. Services
Consultant will provide consulting services to Client focused on AI workflow implementation during the Term. Consultant will perform the services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with generally accepted industry standards for similar services.

2. Term
The term of this Agreement begins on October 1, 2026 and continues for twelve (12) months unless earlier terminated in accordance with this Agreement.

3. Fees and Payment
Client will pay Consultant a fixed fee of $48,000 for the services under this Agreement. Unless the parties otherwise agree in writing, Consultant may invoice the fixed fee in one or more installments during the Term, and Client will pay undisputed amounts within thirty (30) days after receipt of invoice. Client may withhold only amounts subject to a good-faith written dispute, and the parties will work promptly to resolve any such dispute.

4. Deliverables and Ownership
Client will own the final deliverables specifically created by Consultant for Client under this Agreement, but only after Client has paid the fixed fee in full.

Consultant retains all right, title, and interest in and to Consultant’s pre-existing tools, software, templates, methodologies, know-how, processes, and other materials developed or owned by Consultant independent of this Agreement (“Pre-Existing Tools”). To the extent any Pre-Existing Tools are incorporated into or necessary to use the deliverables, Consultant grants Client a non-exclusive, non-transferable, perpetual license to use those Pre-Existing Tools solely as embedded in or necessary for Client’s internal use of the deliverables.

5. Confidentiality
Each party may receive non-public, confidential, or proprietary information from the other party in connection with this Agreement. The receiving party will use the disclosing party’s confidential information only as necessary to perform or receive services under this Agreement and will not disclose that information to any third party except to its employees, contractors, or professional advisers who have a need to know and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as those in this Agreement. These obligations do not apply to information that is or becomes public through no fault of the receiving party, was already lawfully known by the receiving party without restriction, is lawfully received from a third party without breach of obligation, or is independently developed without use of the disclosing party’s confidential information.

6. Independent Contractor
Consultant is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner, joint venturer, or agent of Client. Consultant has no authority to bind Client or incur obligations on Client’s behalf unless Client expressly authorizes such action in writing. Consultant is solely responsible for its personnel, methods of work, and all taxes, withholdings, insurance, and other statutory or contractual obligations relating to its business and personnel.

7. Client Cooperation
Client will provide reasonable cooperation, information, access, and timely decisions as needed for Consultant to perform the services. Consultant is not responsible for delays caused by Client’s failure to provide required cooperation or materials in a timely manner.

8. Warranties and Disclaimer
Consultant warrants that it will perform the services in a professional and workmanlike manner. Except for the express warranty in this Agreement, Consultant provides the services, deliverables, and any related materials “as is,” and disclaims all other warranties, whether express, implied, statutory, or otherwise, including implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, non-infringement, and any warranty that the services or deliverables will achieve any particular business result.

9. Limitation of Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by law, neither party will be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, or punitive damages, or for any loss of profits, revenue, business opportunity, goodwill, or data, arising out of or relating to this Agreement, even if advised of the possibility of such damages. Except for liability arising from a party’s breach of confidentiality obligations, infringement or misappropriation of the other party’s intellectual property rights, or Client’s payment obligations, each party’s total cumulative liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the total fees payable under this Agreement.

10. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach by the other party if the breach is not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice describing the breach in reasonable detail. Either party may also terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days’ prior written notice to the other party.

Upon termination, Client will pay Consultant for all undisputed amounts earned or due for services performed through the effective date of termination. Sections that by their nature should survive termination, including provisions regarding payment, ownership, confidentiality, disclaimers, limitation of liability, governing law, and miscellaneous terms, will survive.

11. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.

12. Miscellaneous
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter and supersedes all prior or contemporaneous proposals, discussions, or agreements on that subject. Any amendment or modification to this Agreement must be in writing and signed by both parties. Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party’s prior written consent, except that either party may assign this Agreement without consent in connection with a merger, reorganization, sale of substantially all assets, or similar corporate transaction involving the assigning party. If any provision of this Agreement is held unenforceable, the remaining provisions will remain in full force and effect. No waiver of any provision of this Agreement will be effective unless in writing. Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and sent to the email addresses set forth below or to any updated contact information provided by notice.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement.

Harbor Peak Analytics LLC

Email: maya.chen@harborpeak.test

Ironvale Manufacturing Inc
